Reviewed the complete current claim and all evidence. The sole implementation region in sage_meta::todo and sole annotated test sage_meta::todo::book_sections_have_distinct_roles (test:spec_plan) are explicitly TODO. The function contains no assertions or behavior; the file introduction expressly defers implementation and focused tests to implementation-plan stages. Its comment defers checks of introductory guidance, normative Design, RFD records, and exclusion of outside-Design definitions. This is a justified pending documentation-role validation, not implemented coverage.

All claim aspects remain covered by that deferral: the Design overview's Meta/Tenets/Anchors/Crates/RFDs composition; Meta describing the specification system; Tenets expressing principles without anchors; generation of Anchors from every active rule; Crates combining handwritten navigation and modeled chapters; RFDs preserving changes/rationale without active rules; and non-normative User's Guide instructions. Completing the TODO requires book-organization/source-role validation and focused fixtures/assertions for those section roles, generation completeness, and exclusion of definitions in non-normative material. The current placeholder would detect none of those violations, and is accepted only with its explicit TODO status, consistently with the captured review policy.

Independently verified exact byte equality of current spec_plan.rs against both historical implementation_sources and test_sources; reassessed the captured historical rationale against the full current claim, source, and complete association set. No additional behavior helpers are involved. Source inspection and baseline comparison establish this deferral assessment, not test execution. Personally executed review start and review read and submitted review record; ran no behavior tests or build. The coordinator's 321 passing functional tests and successful root build are separately supplied execution context and do not establish this placeholder's behavior.
